post_headline: COWBOYS' STEPHEN JONES ON PICKENS
description: The Dallas Cowboys are putting off the question about paying both CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens long-term until after the 2026 season.

post_headline: CHRISTIAN GONZALEZ DOESN'T COMMIT TO PLAYING SEASON OPENER
description: Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez still doesn't have a contract extension, and with the season opener only four days away, he isn't not committing to playing without one.

post_headline: 49ERS PLACE DE SAM OKUAYINONU ON IR
description: 49ers defensive end Sam Okuayinonu won't play against the Rams on Thursday and he will miss at least three more games as well.

post_headline: ARCH MANNING THROWS FOR 305 YARDS
description: Texas quarterback Arch Manning, the betting favorite to be the first overall pick in the 2027 NFL draft, had an easy start to his season today.

post_headline: HARRISON SMITH RETURNING TO VIKINGS ON ONE-YEAR DEAL
description: The veteran safety will be back with Minnesota for his 15th pro season.
